t: A low-power STM32 chip with strong security for battery gadgets.
steps: Buy a WeAct STM32U585 Core Mini from the WeAct Studio AliExpress store for under 8 US dollars.
Download the MicroPython firmware for the WEACTSTUDIO_MINI_STM32U585 board.
Hold the boot button, plug in the USB-C cable, and flash the firmware with dfu-util.
Install the free Thonny editor and pick the MicroPython interpreter.
Run a short script that blinks the onboard LED.
Add a temperature sensor and print its readings.
Try a Nucleo-U575ZI-Q and Zephyr later for C projects. Leave TrustZone off at first.
